title: Strategy page shows approved for dead strategies and no rule or parameters

hosted_verification.statement: Hosted verification was not run in this task; this file records functional unit, typecheck, and fixture e2e evidence only. Hosted acceptance is owned by downstream task STRATEGY-VIEW-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.

ac1_default_tab_query_count_and_notice.detail: Default tab of /management/strategies requests GET /bff/strategies?exclude_state=draft&hide_retired_personas=true&page_size=20, derives its tab count from page_info.total instead of a client-side sum, and displays the notice reporting both hidden draft count from meta.state_counts.draft and hidden retired-persona strategy count from meta.hidden_retired_persona_count.

ac2_other_tabs_and_unreported_counts.detail: Approved, review, retired, draft, and all tabs preserve their existing queries and counts; when meta.state_counts or meta.hidden_retired_persona_count is null or omitted, no label or notice displays an unreported or invented number.

ac3_list_operational_status_and_symbols_.detail: /management/strategies renders an operationalStatus run-status column with distinct localized labels and badges for running, idle, retired, unbound, and unknown (never displaying unknown as running or retired), plus a symbols column derived from row.symbols.

ac4_detail_overview_operational_status_a.detail: /management/strategies/:id Overview tab renders operationalStatus and each bound persona from personaStates with its state badge and a direct link to /management/personas/<personaId> next to LifecycleStepper.

ac5_spec_tab_fields_and_rule_sentences.detail: StrategySpecTab renders spec.title, spec.hypothesis, and spec.objective when present, formats each close_to_close_momentum rule into one plain-language sentence via strategyRuleText.ts from strategyLogic and parameters, labels rollback_baseline rules as a no-order rollback baseline, and reports any other strategyLogic.kind as unsupported with its raw kind without inventing a sentence.

ac6_readonly_parameters_and_removed_empt.detail: StrategyParamsEditor renders trading rule parameters read-only with each adjustableControls entry showing currentValue, allowedRange (min..max), and step, and each immutableParameters key marked fixed; the constant empty params array in StrategyDetail.tsx is removed and no edit or submit control is offered.

ac7_degraded_and_empty_truth_states.detail: rules: null renders a rules-unavailable state on both Spec and Parameters tabs, rules: [] renders that no trading rule is recorded, and operationalStatus: 'unknown' states that persona state could not be read; covered by StrategyDetail.spec.test.tsx with the exact real BFF payload shapes from the task brief.

ac8_strategy_rule_text_unit_coverage.detail: strategyRuleText.test.ts covers the real trading bundle (artifact-persona-paper-b9f9e2e4d44cdd44d160), the real rollback baseline bundle (artifact-persona-paper-baseline-b9f9e2e4d44cdd44d160), threshold 0.005 with lookback_bars 5, and unknown action values in both zh-TW and en-US.

ac9_dto_i18n_parity_and_scope.detail: Strategy and StrategySpecDetail in src/lib/bff-v1/dto.ts gain the new optional operational and rule fields, all new strings exist in both src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts, i18nParity.test.ts passes, and no unrelated pages were modified.
